---
description: Fix a bug in the Exult engine or tools with a minimal change and a test
---

Fix the bug described in ${input:bug:issue number or description}.

1. Read `AGENTS.md`. Find the code from symbol names (grep), not guessed files.
   The layout is: engine in the repo root, `objs/`, `gumps/`, `usecode/`,
   `shapes/`, `files/`, `audio/`, `pathfinder/`, `mapedit/`, `tools/`.
2. Reproduce first. If it needs the original game data or a display, say so and
   reason from the code instead of claiming a reproduction.
3. Where `tests/` can reach the code (see `tests/run-unit-tests.sh` and
   `tests/e2e/run.sh`), add a test that fails before the fix and passes after.
   Test inputs must be generated by the test; never add game data.
4. Make the smallest change. Match `.clang-format` on the lines you touch and
   do not reformat the rest of the file.
5. Touching `files/`, `gamedat.cc` or serialization in `objs/` is a Tier 3
   change (savegame/file-format compatibility): say so and describe the
   compatibility impact.
6. Run `tests/run-unit-tests.sh` (and `tests/e2e/run.sh` for `tools/`, `files/`,
   `shapes/`). Record the exact commands and results.
7. Commit with `git commit -s`; open the PR with
   `gh pr create --repo Danathar/exult --base master --head <branch>`, using the
   PR template, with `Closes #N` if there is an issue. State what you could not
   verify.
